title: Edit my introduction and optional email
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Use a multiline MUI TextField for a short plain-text introduction and a labelled optional unverified email field. Save or cancel edits, clear either field and restore saved values on reopen.

**Verify** · Test empty, multiline, over-limit and markup-like input, failed save and account switch. Only the signed-in member can edit their own profile.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-070

**Queue** · Follows WI-072 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
evidence: The profile form saves the introduction and optional email through PATCH /profile; the server enforces the 500-character and email rules and returns the saved profile.
